clock_target.error_branch: Nonzero vDSO/syscall results write native TLS errno. The compiled C++ clock helper enters its error/exception branch; no recoverable Python-error guarantee is established.
clock_target.ordinary_success: Only owned timespec output writes; no errno store or lazy vDSO pointer initialization in the inspected successful libc branches.
clock_target.transitive_boundary: Reads loader-initialized GLRO(dl_vdso_clock_gettime64) / vDSO or makes Linux clock_gettime syscall. Runtime vDSO/kernel image/effect validation is not supplied by static libc identity.

completion.energy_gate: Direct mj_energyPos clears both energy values and mj_energyVel returns when mjENBL_ENERGY is disabled; skip energy-only prerequisites in that branch.

combined_order_for_three_projections: mj_flex if potential-energy flex prerequisites are needed
mj_tendon if potential-energy tendon lengths or kinetic tendon armature are needed
mj_crb if kinetic energy is computed
mj_tendonArmature if kinetic energy is computed and its contribution is nonzero
existing_detailed_contract.energy_work_gate: mjENBL_ENERGY enabled; otherwise skip energy prerequisite stages, but preserve energyPos clearing both entries followed by energyVel no-op.
external_effect_limits: No control/passive/sensor/plugin callback is introduced by the selected stage bodies or their bounded normal math/Jacobian/wrapping routes.
No native RNG function occurs in the retained normal stage routes. Sensor noise stages are excluded.

Allocation failures and invalid model/type/wrap/interpolation invariants can enter native diagnostic handlers. The version-matched error/TLS/global-logging contract remains necessary; default logging is not side-effect-free.

Libm, SIMD intrinsics, memory helpers and compile-time macros remain explicit leaves of the lexical source record. This record is not compiled call-graph, resident-code, or whole-process effect attestation.

existing_detailed_contract.native_state_boundary: Keep copied qpos, qvel, qacc, applied inputs, stored forces and constraints unchanged as native stored state. potential_projection.energy_enable_behavior: If mjENBL_ENERGY is disabled, energyPos clears both energy entries and returns; energyVel returns unchanged.
potential_projection.free_joint_limit: The retained free-joint branch normalizes a copied four-element qpos slice before its translational spring term. Do not silently replace it with a hand-written corrected formula.
potential_projection.gravity_input: xipos is required when gravity is enabled; joint spring terms use qpos and qpos_spring.
potential_projection.term_limits: Preserve the source result. This function does not add arbitrary plugin potential energy or flex dimension > 1 elastic energy.

existing_detailed_contract.scope: Three completion projections and their necessary data stages; not an API inventory or provider-readiness denominator.
serial_scratch_preconditions: Separate owned mjData allocation with copied state and a stable, internally consistent compiled mjModel.
No active stack frame in the source; do not enter completion concurrently with a writer.
threadpool == 0 for the ordinary owned-stack route; the shared thread-pool stack route is outside this contract.
The separate copy/allocation, callable/image custody, and TLS/logging contracts still apply.
existing_detailed_contract.sleep_contract: These retained stage bodies do not have the later sleep-filter branches.

completion.kinetic_tendon_requirement: No tendon/actuator armature term exists in these pinned mass routines.
order_for_combined_energy_subtree_projec: mj_flex when native potential-energy flex edge lengths are read

completion.potential_flex_requirement: When the native spring branch runs, an eligible flex has !flex_rigid, flex_edgestiffness != 0, flex_dim <= 1 and at least one !flexedge_rigid within [flex_edgeadr, flex_edgeadr+flex_edgenum). mj_flex supplies current flexedge_length; this energy function does not add arbitrary higher-dimensional/plugin elastic energy.
completion.potential_tendon_requirement: When the native spring branch runs and ntendon > 0, prepare mj_tendon. The source reads ten_length even when tendon_stiffness is zero; do not infer an omission from zero stiffness. Modern sleep filtering is retained, but running the declared full tendon stage avoids handwritten active populations.
